fusions.name: Pot Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a round into the first enemy in its path for 7 damage, and you heal for 10% of the damage dealt. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Gorging Volley
fusions.desc: Fires 3 rounds in a spread, each dealing 18 damage and ignoring resistances. 30% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the next 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Share the Bag
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, 1% more for every 1% of cast speed you have.

fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
